description: Tape-style wow and flutter: the input is pitch-shifted by two random modulators running at different speeds

params.text: Sets the rate of the slower modulation, 0.1Hz to 5Hz
Sets the rate of the faster modulation, 5Hz to 30Hz
Sets how far the slower modulation moves the pitch; the setting is squared before use, so the lower half of the knob does very little
Sets how far the faster modulation moves the pitch; the setting is squared before use, so the lower half of the knob does very little

inputs.text: Adds to both depth knobs, 5V covering the whole range, and each total is held between none and full
Nothing in the module reads this jack; both depths come from the two depth knobs and the DETUNE jack

notes: The modulators are shared by every polyphonic voice, so all voices drift together.

inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
